fields.values: One {name, value} entry per column of the node's single output row. A source node: it has no inputs.
fields.values[].name: The column name.
fields.values[].value: Always written as a string. A value that reads as a number becomes a Float64 column ("350" becomes 350.0); anything else stays a string column.

configs.name: minimal
configs.intent: A base rate to multiply relativities onto.

configs.intent: Rating constants: a base rate, a minimum premium and the tariff version.
